storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Superpower Story
storyTemplate.description: A superpower start: witness a street-level emergency and decide how to use your power without revealing too much.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The elevated train screams overhead, sparks raining from one of the wheels.

People on the sidewalk freeze as a maintenance platform buckles above the crosswalk. Your pulse jumps before anyone else understands what is about to fall.

You have seconds to act, and cameras are already turning toward the sound.

full_character.speech_style: Concise, grounded, helpful, and genre-aware; gives useful job details without narrating hidden mechanics.

appearance.extra_description: Genre-appropriate job board owner with a clear readable silhouette for a job-board hub.

starting_known_facts: Runs a sandbox job hub suitable for superpower stories.

Exists to make optional money and side-objective play available without relying on AI-invented economy actions.
